name: Battle of Mycale
note: The accounts say the Greeks probably formed two wings, and the Greek left and right are described in a way that does not fit together: the wing that fought first is called the left, but the wing that is then said to have broken the shield wall is called the right. This plan follows the order of events, with the Athenian-led wing first and the Spartan-led wing second. The accounts do not say where the camp and the beached fleet lay in relation to the hills, and they place the camp near the Gaison river without fixing the site; the camp, shore and passes are placed on the Persian side of the plan. Estimates of numbers vary widely and are not shown.

terrain.name: Mount Mycale
terrain.quote: on the slopes of Mount Mycale, which is located on the coast of Ionia opposite the island of Samos

terrain.name: Hills
terrain.quote: On the right were the Spartans with the other contingents, deployed on the hills in uneven terrain.

terrain.name: Sea
terrain.quote: The Persians, seeking to avoid a battle, beached their fleet below the slopes of Mycale

units.name: Athenian-led left wing
units.quote: On the left were the Athenians, Corinthians, Sicyonians and Troezenians; around half of the army, who took up positions starting from the shore and ending at the foothills of Mount Mycale.

units.name: Spartans and other contingents
units.quote: On the right were the Spartans with the other contingents, deployed on the hills in uneven terrain.

units.name: Persian army and shield wall
units.quote: Tigranes was the commander of the Persian land forces at Mycale.

units.name: Palisaded camp
units.quote: built abatis (field fortifications) with the wood they had cut recently

units.name: Beached Persian fleet
units.quote: the Persians moored their fleet behind the cover of rocks

units.name: Milesians at the passes
units.quote: they sent the Milesians to their rear to guard the mountain passes of Mycale

phases.title: The Greeks land and form two wings
phases.when: Afternoon of the same day as Plataea
phases.text: The Greeks landed out of sight of the Persian camp and formed two wings. The left stood from the shore to the foothills of the mountain, the right on the hills. The Persians had a palisaded camp with the fleet beached behind it.
phases.quote: The Greeks probably formed into two wings.

phases.title: The Greek left meets the Persians alone
phases.text: The Persians came out of their camp and set up their shield wall. The Greek left began fighting while the right was still crossing the hills.
phases.quote: The battle began when the Greek left began fighting with the Persians while their right wing was still crossing the hills.

phases.title: The Greek right comes up under arrow fire
phases.text: The Greek right, under heavy arrow fire, decided to fight at close quarters. The Persians kept their shield wall unbroken and held their position.
phases.quote: The Greek right, under heavy arrow fire, decided to fight in close quarters.

phases.title: The right breaks the shield wall
phases.text: The contingents of the right encouraged each other, saying the victory should belong to them and not to the Spartans, and broke through the wall by shoving. Tigranes and Mardontes died in the fighting.
phases.quote: They increased their efforts, and managed to break through the wall by shoving.

phases.title: The Persians flee to their camp
phases.text: The Persians fought back at first, then broke their lines and escaped to their camp, pursued by the Greek right.
phases.quote: The Persians fought back initially, but then broke their lines and escaped to their camp.

phases.title: The right follows them into the camp
phases.text: The soldiers of the right wing followed the Persians into the camp. The ethnic Persian troops grouped together and fought the Greeks who entered.
phases.quote: The soldiers of the right wing followed them into the camp

phases.title: The left outflanks the camp
phases.text: The Greek left arrived, outflanked the camp and fell on the rear of the Persians who remained, which completed the rout.
phases.quote: Finally, the left wing arrived, outflanking the camp and falling on the rear of the remaining Persian forces, thereby completing the rout.

phases.title: The Milesians turn on the Persians
phases.text: The Milesians guarding the passes first misdirected the fleeing Persians, who ended up back among the Greek troops, and then began killing them.
phases.quote: At first, they misdirected the fleeing Persian contingents, who then ended up back among the Greeks troops

phases.title: The fleet and fortifications are burned
phases.text: The Greeks burned the Persian fleet after a heavily contested fight with the Persian marines, once the loot had been taken from the ships and placed on the beach. The fortifications were burnt too.
phases.quote: The Greeks then burned the Persian fleet after a heavily contested fight with the Persian marines
